reports.summary: Finished the G-panels leftovers and the three cross-area items. (1) D-07: the queue row now uses the shared MXRPlayerMenus.addToPlaylist submenu (playlists load on open; New Playlist…; per-playlist errors go through app.dialogs). The private QueuePlaylistPicker popup and the playlistTarget state are deleted. A row inside a multi-row selection adds the whole selection in queue order (PanelQueueInteraction.media). The item is now shown disabled, rather than hidden, when there is no media library, as in the mini player and the player menus. (2) S20.Sidebar/subtitles-appearance no longer declares figmaNode 800:1126, so `check --all` reports `skip (no figmaNode)` instead of a spurious size FAIL. The notes and a code comment keep the frame and slider node ids, the reason, and the geometry to compare against figma_file.json (86 pt rows on a 91 pt pitch, 6/4/11 stops). Nothing is masked. (3) The panel test files compile and pass. PanelAuditRegressionTests already uses MXRPlayerMenus.playlist(...).children and ThemeContrastTests no longer references readableSecondary, both at HEAD. I added a behaviour test for the queue row's Add to Playlist media resolution. (4) The verifier's G-09 minor: a bookmark rename in progress is now saved, not dropped, when you click another bookmark row, use Rename on another row, press + to add a bookmark, change tab, or close the panel. Rows cannot take focus (D028), so the TextField's focus loss never fired in those cases. Build is clean. Panel suites pass: PanelAuditRegressionTests 9/9 (incl. the new test), PanelsTests 5/5, SidePanelContentTests 3/3, ThemeContrastTests 8/8, MenuAuditRegressionTests, PanelValuesRegressionTests 4/4. Offscreen checks: S22.Queue/default REVIEW (only the documented header-total difference), S23.Queue/bookmarks REVIEW. I looked at both next to Figma.

issues.description: The new test only checks the pure media-resolution helper (PanelQueueInteraction.media). It does not check that the queue row's context menu really contains the shared Add to Playlist submenu (New Playlist…, a separator, then the playlists). The wiring was verified by reading QueuePanel.swift:236-243 and :356. MenuAuditRegressionTests covers the shared submenu itself. A small test that builds the queue row's menu items would close the gap.

With figmaNode removed, `check --all` correctly reports skip, but `check --id S20.Sidebar/subtitles-appearance` now exits 2 with an error (no figmaNode). This is expected tool behaviour, not a product issue. The row geometry can now only be compared by eye or with figma_file.json. I rendered it and it matches r1's geometry check: text values over 6/4/11-stop ticked sliders, Outline thumb at stop 2.
Auto is still at stop 0 with no fill, while Figma 804:1341 has it at stop 3. This was documented and left as an owner decision, not a defect of this pass.

These panel entries still FAIL `check`. S17 fails on the D033 row set (Waveform and Metadata rows, Reverse disabled with an info icon, Statistics absent) and the resulting surface-colour shift; I looked at the side-by-side and confirmed this. S20.Presets fails on homeCard vs bgA4, Δ2, which belongs to the tokens area. S21 fails on the timeline accent fill, a documented timeline note. The same causes as r1; nothing new and nothing masked.

verdict.summary:
Round 2 verification of G-panels at HEAD 4c457baa03 plus the working tree.

Cross-area item (1), D-07: done. The queue row's context menu now uses MXRPlayerMenus.addToPlaylist(app, isEnabled: hasMediaLibrary, newPlaylist:, media:, onError: app.dialogs.presentError), the same call the mini player makes (MXRMiniPlayerView.swift:235). The private QueuePlaylistPicker popup, its separate LibraryModel and the playlistTarget state are deleted (-62 lines). The row adds the whole selection in queue order when it is part of a multi-row selection (PanelQueueInteraction.media), otherwise only itself. "New Playlist…" passes the same media. The item is disabled, not hidden, when there is no media library.

Cross-area item (2): done. S20.Sidebar/subtitles-appearance no longer declares figmaNode, and `check --all` prints `skip (no figmaNode)`. The notes keep the node ids and the geometry. I rendered both the Relative and Pixels variants and looked at them: Font Size, Outline Thickness and Background Opacity show text values over 6/4/11-stop ticked sliders, as r1 confirmed against figma_file.json. No mask or threshold was added.

Cross-area item (3): done. playlistDestinations and readableSecondary have no remaining references. The panel suites pass in the shared package: PanelAuditRegressionTests 9/9, PanelsTests 5/5, SidePanelContentTests 3/3, ThemeContrastTests 8/8, PanelValuesRegressionTests 4/4 and MenuAuditRegressionTests, 33+4 tests with 0 failures. The MXRUISnapshotTests target compiles again.

G-09 click-away: done. saveBookmarkName() is now called on a tap on another row, on Rename of another row (beginRename saves first), on + Add bookmark, on a tab change and in onDisappear. The TextField's focus-loss handler, Return and Esc are kept. An empty name keeps the old one.

Remaining findings, unchanged since r1 and still in place in code and renders:
- G-01, G-02, G-06, G-07 and G-08: S18 and S20 are REVIEW, with the Rotate field, the active HDR Auto dropdown, no Resolution caption and field-only offset rows.
- G-03, G-04 and G-10: key routing, the activate-only focusable rows with an fgA1 ring, and no zero-distance DragGesture.
- G-11, G-13 and G-15: values.
- G-14: S17 shows the timeline toggle enabled.

check --all for panel entries: S14, S15, S16, S18, S19, S20, S22, S23, S24 and C.Dropdown are REVIEW with 1–2 pt offsets. S17, S20.Presets and S21 FAIL for the documented, already-known reasons; I looked at the S17 side-by-side myself.

Other checks:
- swift build is clean.
- The engine diff (git diff upstream-base-2026-10-14 -- src lib include modules/gui/macosx) is empty.
- Ownership is respected: only QueuePanel.swift, PanelsGallery.swift and one panel test file were changed. Another agent changed the EffectsSidebars Cast label to "Discover Cast Devices", a copy-only change.
- The new code uses tokens only.

No blocker or major remains. The keyboard, FKA, drag and live submenu behaviour still needs the live-acceptance checks below.
